answer: Useful-work admission treats each identity like quartz grown, not copied: a device must complete six hours of scientific computation, such as protein-folding units, whose checkpoint hashes chain to a harbor beacon seed, so work cannot be precomputed or reused. Each unit locks 40 POA for four epochs, and a raven-flagged cluster of identical hardware fingerprints is audited and slashed. One machine doing one unit per epoch makes ten fakes cost sixty hours plus 400 POA. Limits: GPU farms and energy waste remain, so cap admissions per epoch, rotate work types, and add liveness checks and appeals.
